requirement_text: If you are a citizen of EU, EEA or Switzerland, you generally do not pay application and tuition fees. However, some joint programmes may charge fees from EU/EEA/Swiss citizens. If you are not a citizen of EU, EEA or Switzerland, you usually have to pay application and tuition fees, with some exceptions.
source_authority_note: kth.se is the official domain of KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm (website_url on the matched universities row is https://www.kth.se). Swedish national domain, so it fails looksOfficial()'s .edu/.ac./.gov suffix test. Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A) of source-authority-gap.md.
limitations: Carries a real exception in the EU/EEA direction -- 'some joint programmes may charge fees from EU/EEA/Swiss citizens'. A rule stored as the flat predicate 'EU/EEA => no fee' would be wrong for those programmes.
researcher_notes: Worth holding against the national portal's page, which states the citizenship split without the joint-programme carve-out. Not a conflict: KTH is authoritative about its own joint programmes, and the portal is describing the general national rule.

requirement_text: The full tuition fee for most two-year programmes with both years spent at KTH is SEK 360,000, but it varies between the programmes.
source_authority_note: kth.se is the official domain of KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm (website_url on the matched universities row is https://www.kth.se). Swedish national domain, so it fails looksOfficial()'s .edu/.ac./.gov suffix test. Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A) of source-authority-gap.md.
limitations: 'most ... but it varies between the programmes' -- a modal, not a rule. The programme-level figure is the authoritative one and is published per programme.
researcher_notes: Full-programme figure (two years), not per year. Storing it beside Aalto's and DTU's per-academic-year fees without a period qualifier would understate KTH by half.

requirement_text: Students applying for studies at KTH through University Admissions are required to pay an application fee of SEK 900. This fee must be paid by the document submission deadline, since the assessment of the application is dependent on payment of the fee.
source_authority_note: kth.se is the official domain of KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm (website_url on the matched universities row is https://www.kth.se). researcher_notes: KTH restates the national SEK 900 fee. Consistent with the operator's own page. The deadline is expressed relationally ('by the document submission deadline') rather than as a date, which is the correct shape for a fee KTH does not itself schedule.
